metadata.title: That 1 kill where I swear the game whispered ‘Take it, just this once’ LOL
metadata.description:
Wait, did the game just gift me a kill?
Enemy probably paused to question life.
Click if you’ve ever gotten kills you didn’t earn!
Valorant logic at peak trolling again.

Tap in if your kills are all a happy accident!

#valorant #luckshot #gamingfails #funnygaming #shorts
